source: probed by hand 2026-11-22 against opencode 1.19.6 (rig: fake Anthropic model, a PTY, Novadeck's headless emulator)
how: Each state read with `readScreen`: `rows` holds the rows that show anything, `bright` those whose dim cells blank some of their text, `cursor` the cursor; paths in the footer made `~/project`. Names ending 60 are 60x20, the rest 120x40.
